strings.(성역 에이도스의 안쪽에 있는 맹약의 성소에 도착했을 때, 이리스의 손길: (Upon reaching the Sanctum of the Covenant deep within Eidos, a breeze as warm as Iris's touch blows past.)
strings.(바람을 따라 맹약의 성소 뒤쪽의 작은 길 앞에 섰을 때, 문득 간밤에: (Following the breeze to a small path behind the sanctum, you suddenly seem to recall last night's dream.)
I'm sure I dreamed something, but I can't remember any of it.
strings.이리스를 만나러 가자. 날 부른 거 맞겠지?: Let's go see Iris. She is calling me, isn't she?
What could it be? Nothing seems urgent right now...
strings.(그렇게 바람과 함께 다가온 작은 빛은 손님을 어딘가로 데려간다.): (A tiny light arrives with the wind and carries the visitor away.)
strings.(빛이 다가와 사라진 틈 사이로 환하게 웃는 이리스의 모습이 다가온다.): (As the approaching light fades, Iris appears with a radiant smile.)
I was thinking how much I wanted to see you. I didn't expect you to come like this.
I thought you might be calling me...
You could have simply spoken to me.
Oh, right. Ahaha. I suppose I could have.
There's something I need to tell you.
There's something I need to check with her, as Lady Gaia's incarnation.
So hold on tight. I don't know how we'll land this time.
I'll be hurt if you look so alarmed. Don't be too nervous.
(After a few steps with Iris, a familiar place comes into view. Familiar cries greet them as creatures approach.)
Oh, so many beautiful, adorable mythical beasts!
strings.아, 아드리카구나. 이리스는 동물 좋아해?: Ah, Adrica. Do you like animals, Iris?
strings.네, 좋아해요. 먼저 공격해오지만 않는다면 말이죠. 여행 중에는 자주 물: Yes, as long as they don't attack first. I was bitten and hurt quite often during my travels.
strings.그건 나도 그래. 이 아이들도 처음엔 날 나쁜 사람인 줄 알고 따라오면서: Me too. These little ones thought I was bad at first. They followed me around, poking and biting me.
It's only natural to be wary of someone unfamiliar.
strings.유독 이런 아이들이 좋아하는 대상이 있어요. 그 중에서 레비 님이라던가…: There are people they're especially fond of, though. Like Lady Levi...
strings.(두 사람의 발걸음이 멈춘 자리 멀리에 멍하니 서 있는 미뉴에트의 모습이: (In the distance, Minuet stands gazing blankly ahead.)
strings.(미뉴에트가 두 사람을 알아보더니 눈을 깜빡이고, 손을 흔들어 아는 척을: (Minuet recognizes them, blinks, and waves in greeting.)
Minuet? Her mouth is moving, but I can't hear her voice...
Perhaps because Lady Gaia has gone so far away, she isn't connected to Minuet. Minuet says she's fine, but...
strings.(미뉴에트가 조금은 멍한 눈빛으로 이리스를 바라본다.): (Minuet looks at Iris with a slightly vacant gaze.)
A god's absence must affect their incarnation, too.
strings.이리스, 혹시 가이아 님이 계신 곳을 알고 있는 거야? 멀리 가셨다고 했: Iris, do you know where Lady Gaia is? You said she'd gone far away.
strings.아드키나 님을 만나기 위해 잠깐 오셨다가 가신 것 같아요. 그래서 제가: It seems she came back briefly to see Lord Atkina, then left again. That's how I found out.
strings.이리스는 가이아 님이 왜 그러셨는지 알아?: Do you know why she did that?
strings.정확하지는 않지만, 제게 힘을 실어주시려고 한 것 같아요. 저도 가이아: I'm not certain, but I think she wanted to lend me her strength. I want to speak with her, too, but...
She went to a refuge between Etoile and another world... I can't leave this place unattended.
strings.그러면 누군가 대신 갈 수는 있는 거야?: Could someone go in your place?
Yes. I promised not to hide things from you, so I'll tell you.
strings.갈 수 있어요. 하지만, 위험해요. 보통 사람이 가기에 그곳은 온갖 시간: It's possible. But dangerous. For an ordinary person, that place is a tangle of countless times and souls...
It's dangerous! To go there in a human body...
I'll go see Lady Gaia. She might be waiting.
I'll allow it. Just this once.
When you're ready, come near the entrance to the Sanctum of the Covenant. I'll prepare as well.
strings.(미뉴에트가 알았다는 듯이 고개를 끄덕이자 이리스가 살며시 미소를 짓는다: (Minuet nods in understanding. Iris smiles softly, then quietly disappears.)
strings.이리스가 저정도로 말하는 걸 보면 분명 위험한 곳이겠지. 준비 단단히 해: If Iris is that worried, it must be dangerous. I'd better prepare carefully. I'll be going, Minuet.
I'll make sure to find Lady Gaia...
strings.(준비를 마치고 맹약의 성소 입구 앞에 도착했을 때, 이리스의 손길 같은: (Once your preparations are complete, you arrive at the sanctum's entrance. A breeze like Iris's touch blows once more.)
strings.(그러나 이전과는 달리 바람은 불안정한 느낌으로 불어왔다 사라지기를 반복: (Unlike before, however, it comes and goes unsteadily.)
I'm fine. It's a power I've never used before. I'm just not accustomed to it.
strings.%s, 다시 한번 물어볼게요. 그곳에 가겠다는 뜻은 변함없나요?: %s, let me ask once more. Are you still certain you want to go?
Yes. I haven't changed my mind.
Close your eyes. I'll send you there.
strings.%s의 발걸음이 닿아야 할 곳은 이곳과는 다른 시간을 품은…. 시간과 공: The place your footsteps must reach, %s, holds a time different from this one... Between the boundaries of time and space...
strings.(이리스의 목소리가 흐릿하게 들려오더니 더는 들려오지 않는다. 그러다 순: (Iris's voice grows faint, then falls silent. Suddenly, everything in %s's view seems to distort.)
strings.(앞에 보이던 것들이 일그러졌다 돌아오기를 반복하다 멈춘다. 어느 정도: (Everything ahead repeatedly twists and returns to normal, then stops. After some time, you lift your head to find an unfamiliar space within the darkness.)
I think there's light over there. Is that the way out? I'd better look.
strings.(빛을 따라 걸어가던 %s의 앞에 낯선 공간이 펼쳐진다. 하지만, 다가오: (Following the light, %s enters an unfamiliar space. Yet the air feels strangely familiar.)
I've definitely never seen this place before...
strings.(다가오는 달빛 사이로 아름다운 해안선이 펼쳐진다. 섬을 감싸는 것 같은: (A beautiful coastline unfolds in the moonlight. Small stars fall one by one above clouds that seem to encircle the island.)
strings.지엔디아에도, 프레이오스에도, 이스트랜드에도 이런 바닷가는 본 적이 없어: I've never seen a beach like this in Jiendia, Freios, or Eastland...
strings.(시원한 바람에 박자를 맞추듯 작은 파도가 일어난다. 그때마다 어딘가에: (Small waves rise in time with the cool breeze. With each wave, hidden beings emerge and roam about.)
strings.…날 봐도 아무렇지도 않게 그냥 지나가네. 어디로 가는 걸까?: ...They just walk past, untroubled by me. Where are they going?
strings.일단 따라 가볼까? 저기 누구지?: Should I follow? Who's that over there?
strings.(다른 곳에서 보지 못했던 모습의 정령들을 따라간 한적한 장소 앞에 한: (Following spirits unlike any seen elsewhere leads to a quiet place where a girl stands.)
strings.(달빛을 맞으며 서 있던 소녀가 정령들을 보자 환하게 눈인사를 한다.): (Standing in the moonlight, the girl greets the spirits with bright eyes.)
strings.너희들, 왔구나. 즐거웠니?: You're back. Did you have fun?
Don't try to bite me, even as a joke. I'd really hate to be bitten to death.
A spirit I haven't seen before.
strings.(소녀가 정령들의 머리를 쓰다듬다가 %s의 머리도 쓰다듬는다. 하지만 뭔: (The girl pats the spirits' heads, then %s's. Sensing something strange, she pats it again and looks puzzled.)
strings.저기, 놀라지 마세요. 저는 나쁜 사람 아니에요. 아니, 이런 말 하니까: Please don't be scared. I'm not a bad person. Though saying that makes me sound like one... Anyway, I'm not!
strings.…죄, 죄송해요. 사람 보고 놀라는 건 예의가 아닌데. 제가 사람을 너무: ...S-sorry. It's rude to be frightened by someone. I just haven't seen a person in so long... Who are you?
strings.(소녀가 정신을 차리고 %s의 얼굴을 빤히 바라본다.): (The girl regains her composure and stares at %s's face.)
strings.%s, %s 님이군요. 저는 여기 프뉴마에서 지내는 아르케예요. 이름 예: %s. So you're %s. I'm Arche, and I live here in Pneuma. A pretty name, isn't it?
I've heard a great deal about you, %s. Or rather, I've learned a great deal.
strings.그게…. 여기 가만히 있어도 아래에 다녀온 정령들이 이야기를 해줘서 알게: Well... Even if I stay here, spirits who visit the world below tell me things. Hehe.
strings.그렇다는 건 아르케는 정령인가요? 정령왕? 정령들이 잘 따르는데…. 아니: Does that mean you're a spirit? A Spirit King? They seem to like you... Or are you Lady Gaia's incarnation?
strings.아뇨. 저는 정령도 아니고, 현신도 아니고. 평범한 인간이에요. 그런데: No. I'm neither a spirit nor an incarnation. Just an ordinary human. Though it's strange that I can't leave and only live here, isn't it?
Hehe. The rest is a secret.
strings.아, 어쩌죠? 정령들이 익숙하지 않은 %s의 기운에 놀란 것 같아요. 그: Oh dear. The spirits seem startled by your unfamiliar energy, %s. Could you play with them over there?
Just fight them as you would spar with Valdrick.
strings.일단 그건 이따가 이야기해요. 늦으면 정령들이 %s 님의 손을 붙잡고 나: Let's discuss that later. If you wait too long, the spirits might take your hand, %s, and put you somewhere strange, neither the Abyss nor Purgatory.
Then you'd never see the light again.
strings.이건 이곳의 규칙이라 여기서 지내고 있는 저도 어쩔 수 없어요. 정령에게: Those are this place's rules. Even I can't change them, though I live here. Spirits have their rules, and humans have theirs.
It shouldn't be difficult. Go play with them. I'll wait here.
...Then I'll tell you about Lady Iris and Lady Gaia. Oops, that's a secret.
strings.(조금 의심스러운데…. 진짠지 아닌지 알 수 없지만 어쩔 수 없지.): (This seems a little suspicious... I don't know if it's true, but I have no choice.)
You played nicely with the spirits. They look happy.
strings.발드릭과 대련하는 정도는 아니었지만…. 이제 이리스와 가이아 님의 이야기: It wasn't quite like sparring with Valdrick... Now, tell me about Iris and Lady Gaia.
strings.그러기 전에 이곳이 궁금하지 않으신가요?: Before that, aren't you curious about this place?
strings.여기 이름이 프뉴마라고 하셨죠? 분명 이리스가 그렇게 말했던 것 같은데…: You said it's called Pneuma? I think that's what Iris said...
strings.비밀인데…. 이곳은 프뉴마, '숨의 공간'이라고도 해요. 에트와르에서 ': It's a secret, but... This is Pneuma, also called the 'Space of Breath.' It influences those in Etoile who spend their time in what we call 'life.'
strings.정령들이 열심히 일하면서 긍정적인 신호를 만들어낸답니다. 좋은 시간을 만: They work hard to create positive signals. They make good times and convey good feelings.
strings.제가 살고 있는 시간과 공간과는 확실히 다르다는 거죠? 아까 규칙에 대해: So it's definitely different from the time and space I live in? You mentioned rules earlier...
Yes. The flow itself is different.
strings.정령들의 세계, 정령계 같은 건가요?: Is it a world of spirits? The Spirit Realm?
There are many spirits, but I wouldn't quite call it that.
Still, it feels so comfortable here. Peaceful.
There is no ill energy here because of the protection the ancient gods left behind.
strings.그렇다고 여기 머물면 안 돼요. 이렇게 있다간 다시 원래대로의 시간에 돌: But that doesn't mean you may stay. If you linger like this, you won't be able to return to your original time.
strings.어디까지가 비밀이죠?: How much of this is a secret?
It's no secret that Lady Gaia is here.
strings.가이아 님이 계신 곳을 알려드릴 수는 있지만, %s 님의 힘으로는 닿지: I can tell you where she is, but you can't reach her with your own strength, %s.
strings.아실지 모르겠지만, 가이아 님께선 이곳에…. 어?: I don't know if you're aware, but Lady Gaia is here... Hm?
strings.(갑자기 두 사람이 있는 곳으로 엄청난 숫자의 정령들이 몰려온다.): (An enormous number of spirits suddenly swarms toward them.)
strings.어쩌죠? 정령들을 다시 진정시켜야 할 거 같아요. 아무래도 %s 님에게: Oh dear. I think you'll have to calm them again. You must have some power that draws spirits to you, %s.
An ordinary human wouldn't have come all the way here to speak with a goddess.
strings.…한 번만 더 정령들과 놀아주세요. 드래곤 아드키나 님의 브레스를 맞는다: ...Play with them one more time. As though you're taking a blast of Lord Atkina's dragon breath.
Please hurry. It's the only way to settle time here.
strings.시간이 진정된다는 건 대체 뭐죠? 하여튼 이번 한 번 더 놀아주면 끝난다: What does 'settle time' even mean? Anyway, one more round of playing, and that's it, right?
strings.네, 정령들과 재미있게 놀아주세요!: Yes. Have fun with the spirits!
strings.시험을 치르는 기분이 드는 것 같지만 해볼게요. 그럼 제대로 이야기해줘요: It feels like a test, but I'll do it. Then give me a proper explanation.
Well done. The spirits seem satisfied again.
Though you look a little tired...
...That was a bit harder this time.
strings.잠깐 여기 앉아서 쉬세요. 쉬시는 동안에 숨의 공간인 프뉴마가 %s 님을: Sit here and rest a moment. While you do, Pneuma, the Space of Breath, will prepare to welcome you, %s.
strings.(아르케가 조용히 하늘을 향해 손을 뻗는다. 바다를 향해 떨어지는 별의: (Arche quietly reaches toward the sky. The stars falling toward the sea stop, then disappear.)
strings.%s 님께서 아시는 대로 가이아 님께서는 사랑하는 별을 위해, 사랑하는: As you know, %s, Lady Gaia exhausted her power for the star she loves, and for those dear to her.
strings.그래서 잠이 들었다 깨어나기를 반복하시면서 회복하는 중이셨죠. 깨어나는: She has been recovering by sleeping and waking in cycles. When awake, she uses her power only where it is needed.
strings.하지만, 이번엔 가이아 님께 많은 일이 일어났어요. 성소가 침범을 당하고: But much has happened to her lately. Her sanctum was invaded, and she repeatedly faced those targeting Lady Iris.
As time passes, the star slowly forgets Lady Gaia.
It's a secret, but I'll tell you, %s.
Nothing lasts forever. Every object and every life has its allotted time. Even our beloved star, Etoile...
Even if the star itself does not vanish, it forgets the ancient gods who were with it. Only a handful remain now...
Whenever the star loses its memory of an ancient god, evil beings will come again.
strings.가이아 님께서 현신으로 미뉴에트의 모습이 되셨을 때, 만약 %s 님이 그: When Lady Gaia took the form of her incarnation, Minuet, if you hadn't come there, %s...
strings.그리고 에이도스에서 바르바토스로부터 가이아 님을 구하지 않으셨다면 그렇게: And if you hadn't saved her from Barbatos in Eidos, that would have happened.
strings.(별이 신을 잊는다…, 그러면 신도 별을 잊어가는 걸까? 아…?): (The star forgets its gods... Do the gods forget the star, too? Ah...?)
strings.아르케는 비밀이라면서 다 이야기해주네요. 어디까지 알고 있는 거예요?: You keep saying it's a secret, Arche, but you tell me everything. Just how much do you know?
strings.비밀이라도 어느 정도는 말씀드릴 수 있으니까 괜찮아요. 시간의 흐름, 그: It's fine. Even with secrets, I can tell you a certain amount. I've spent a long time under the influence of the flow of time, here between its currents.
That's the kind of place Pneuma is.
strings.아르케, 그러면 이제 가이아 님을 만날 수 있는 거죠?: Arche, can I see Lady Gaia now?
strings.삶에 흐르는 시간의 영역, 두 개의 공간을 담당하는 정령의 허락이 필요해: You need permission from the spirits responsible for the two spaces within the realm of time that flows through life.
Only then can you visit Lady Gaia, who is between those spaces.
Two time spirits, Chronos and Kairos, divide the space between them and guard it. Go speak with them.
strings.두 정령도 아마 가이아 님의 축복을 받은 %s 님을 인식하고 있을 테니까: They will probably recognize you as someone blessed by Lady Gaia, %s... That's all I can tell you.
strings.먼저 크로노스를 만나러 가보세요. 크로노스는 자신의 이름을 딴 '크로노스: Go see Chronos first. He is within a space named after him: 'Chronos's Time.'
Go to that tent down there. That's the place.
I'll go meet him now. See you later.
strings.(…가이아 님, 과연 %s 님이 시간을 멈출 수 있을까요?): (...Lady Gaia, will %s truly be able to stop time?)
strings.(아르케가 알려준 방향에 있는 천막으로 들어가자 프뉴마와는 다른 모습의: (Entering the tent in the direction Arche indicated reveals a landscape quite different from Pneuma.)
strings.(숲을 이룬 나무보다 큰 거대한 동물 봉제 인형 뒤로 보이는 하늘이 보랏: (Beyond enormous stuffed animals taller than the forest's trees, a violet sunset colors the sky. A strange Ferris wheel turns before them.)
strings.아니…. 시간의 공간, 그런 거라면서 대체…. 놀이공원?: Wait... I thought this was a realm of time. Why is it... an amusement park?
strings.저 관람차는 아무도 탄 사람이 없네. 밤새도록 돌아가는 건가?: No one's riding that Ferris wheel. Does it run all night?
strings.(이상한 의성어와 함께 하늘에서 거대한 새 한 마리가 날아온다. 일반적인: (With that strange cry, an enormous bird descends from the sky. Unlike any ordinary bird, it stares intently at %s's face.)
strings.여기엔 신이 아끼는 인간이라 해도 올 수 없어. 부엉!: Even a human cherished by a god cannot come here. Hoot!
strings.부엉이랑 닮긴 했지만, 부엉이는 아니다, 부엉! 내 이름은 크로노스. 시: I may look like an owl, but I'm not one. Hoot! I am Chronos, a spirit of time. Hoot!
strings.(한쪽 날개로 배를 감싸는 부엉이, 아니 부엉이 모양의 시계가 자신을 소: (An owl... or rather, an owl-shaped clock, introduces itself with one wing folded across its belly.)
strings.(그래서 시계의 모습인가…?): (So that's why he looks like a clock...?)
strings.%s! 반갑다, 부엉! 이리스 님의 사람이니 말 편하게 해라, 부엉!: %s! Good to see you, hoot! You're with Lady Iris, so speak freely. Hoot!
Oh, right. The reason I'm here...
I know why you're here, hoot. You've come to see Lady Gaia.
strings.(크로노스가 들고 있던 낫을 %s 앞에 들이민다.): (Chronos thrusts his scythe in front of %s.)
strings.뭐긴 뭐야. 부엉! 난 이 공간의 관리자로서 해야 할 일을 하는 것뿐이지: What do you think? Hoot! I'm simply doing my duty as this space's keeper. Hoot!
strings.가이아 님을 만나려면 크로노스의 허락이 필요해. 그러니 허락해줘. 이곳에: I need your permission to see Lady Gaia. Please grant it. Stop the time flowing here.
strings.시간을 멈춰 달라고? 여기의 시간이 멈추면 이리스 님이 계신 곳이 어떻게: Stop time? What do you think would happen where Lady Iris is if time stopped here? Hoot?
Oh, this place and that world...
...Though that doesn't mean there's no way. Hoot...
strings.(크로노스가 들고 있던 낫을 거두고, 하늘을 가리킨다.): (Chronos lowers his scythe and points at the sky.)
Feel all the time within this space.
strings.시간의 흐름을 단순하게 봐선 안 된다. 부엉! 내가 이곳을 관리하지만,: Don't take the flow of time lightly. Hoot! I manage this place, but there's a reason I can't do as I please!
strings.이곳은 에트와르의 모든 생명이 일상을, 평범한 시간을 유지할 수 있게 돕: This place is structured to help all life in Etoile maintain its ordinary, everyday time. Hoot!
strings.이곳에 함께 하는 다른 정령들 또한 그 시간을 소중하게 만들 수 있도록: The other spirits here work to make that time precious, too. Hoot.
strings.온몸으로 느끼는 거다, 부엉! 그 시간을 느끼고 내가 있는 곳으로 온다면: Feel it with your whole body, hoot! Experience that time and come find me. Then I'll consider it.
I knew it wouldn't be easy. I'll try.
strings.그래, 부엉? 이 시간을 멈추려고 네가 마음을 먹었지? 지금부터 이 공간: Is that so, hoot? You've resolved to stop this time? From now on, this space, and every spirit within it, will obstruct you. Hoot.
strings.따라 하지 마라, 부엉. 너도 날 부엉이라 생각하는 거냐, 부엉?: Don't copy me, hoot! Do you think I'm an owl, too? Hoot?
strings.(크로노스의 머리에 달린 종이 살짝 울리다 만다. 마치 화가 난 것 같은: (The bell on Chronos's head gives a brief ring. Looking almost angry, he gazes into the distance.)
Owl or not, I'm busy. Come find me. Hoot.
strings.(크로노스가 말을 끝내고 힘차게 날갯짓을 하며 하늘로 올라간다. 그러다: (Chronos beats his wings vigorously and rises into the sky, then flies somewhere beyond the hill.)
strings.일단 가보자. 안 그래도 정령들이 몰려오고 있으니 잘 헤쳐나가는 수밖에…: Let's go. The spirits are already gathering. I'll just have to make my way through...
strings.(모험가를 쫓아오던 정령들에게서 벗어나 한적한 공간에 이르렀을 때, 어디: (After escaping the pursuing spirits and reaching a quiet space, the adventurer hears a clock ticking.)
strings.(이름이 불리자마자 하늘 위에서 거대한 그림자가 내려온다. 커다란 부엉이: (As soon as his name is called, an enormous shadow descends. Chronos, the giant owl-clock spirit, regards the adventurer with the same sullen expression.)
strings.왜 그렇게 보는 거야?: Why are you looking at me like that?
strings.원래 표정이 이렇다, 부엉. 표정이 이런 건, 어쩔 수 없어. 부엉. 날: That's just my face, hoot. I can't help how I look. Hoot. The one who cherished me liked owls... Of all things...
strings.그러고 보니 문득 네가 시간의 흐름이 잘못되는 걸 구해준 게 생각난다,: Come to think of it, I remember you saving the flow of time from going awry. Hoot.
strings.언젠가 인간 중에 하나가 어떤 힘에 의해 시계가 됐지, 부엉?: A human was once turned into a clock by some power, wasn't he? Hoot?
Oh... You mean the magic academy festival.
strings.바이스 나쁜 놈이 사용한 마석의 힘이 내가 있는 '시간'을 일부 파고들었: The magic stones that villain Weiss used penetrated part of the 'time' I inhabit. Hoot.
strings.파고들면서 그 구멍이 생겼고, 그 안의 흐름이 새어나가 윈디 시드에 영향: They made a hole, and the flow within leaked out, affecting Windy Seed. That fellow Zephyros even became a clock. Hoot.
It caused me plenty of trouble. Arche scolded me a lot, too. Hoot.
The being who gave Weiss authority to interfere with time... Hoot.
strings.내가 그 존재에 대해 말할 수 있는 건 여기까지야. 여신님과 이야기하면: That's all I can say about that being. I could say more when speaking with the goddess, but otherwise I cannot. Hoot.
strings.후우, 부엉. 나도 별 이야기를 다하는군. 이제 여기까지 왔으면 느낀 게: Sigh, hoot. Listen to me ramble. Now that you've come this far, you must have felt something. Hoot?
Every time I shook off or faced the spirits, I felt emotions I couldn't understand.
I'm glad you felt them, hoot.
strings.그래도 부족해. 크로노스의 시간을 멈출지 말지는 결정하지 못하겠다, 부엉: But it's still not enough. I can't decide whether to stop Chronos's Time. Hoot.
strings.솔직하게 말하자면 나는 네가 가이아 님을 만나지 않아도 상관없어. 하지만: Honestly, it makes no difference to me whether you meet Lady Gaia. But Lady Iris went to such trouble to send you. You can't simply leave. Hoot.
strings.나는 네가 각오하고 이곳에 왔단 것도 알고 있어. 그만큼 허락받는 게 쉽: I know you came here with resolve. You also know earning permission isn't easy, don't you? Hoot?
(Chronos lifts his wings toward the sky. The realm of time trembles, and he cries out to summon the spirits.)
strings.(크로노스가 갑자기 움직임을 멈추더니 뒤로 물러난다.): (Chronos suddenly stops moving and backs away.)
There's no point in fighting anymore. This will do.
But I won't stop time. Hoot.
strings.멈추는 게 아니라면?: If you won't stop it, then...?
strings.느리게 해 줄게, 부엉. 멈추게 할 수는 있지만, 멈춘다면 프뉴마가 무너: I'll slow it down, hoot. I could stop it, but Pneuma would collapse.
strings.아까 말했던 것처럼 나쁜 놈이 틈을 노려서 덤비면 악영향이 나타나지. 부: As I said, if a villain exploits that opening, terrible things could happen. Hoot.
With so many ancient gods gone, Etoile and this world are still incomplete. Hoot.
strings.아까 정령들을 만나서 많은 걸 느꼈다고 했지, 부엉?: You said you felt many things while meeting the spirits, didn't you? Hoot?
What you felt were emotions. All the emotions of lives that experience time...
strings.많은 사람들의 많은 감정들이 흐르는 시간 속에 실려서 프뉴마에 도착해,: Countless people's feelings ride the flow of time to Pneuma. Hoot. How they arrive is top-secret spirit business. Hoot!
I can't make it sound as charming as Arche, but it's a secret anyway. Hoot.
strings.강하지만 불안하고, 기쁘지만 두려워, 행복하지만 피곤해. 복잡하고 미묘한: Strong yet uneasy, joyful yet afraid, happy yet tired. Those complex, subtle feelings...
strings.뻔한 이야기지만, 프뉴마의 정령들이 지키려고 하는 이 '시간'은 에트와르: It may seem obvious, but this 'time' Pneuma's spirits protect exists for the everyday lives of Etoile's inhabitants. Hoot.
strings.이 정령들이 삶에 긍정적인 감정을 느끼도록 유지할 수 있도록 지켜주거든,: These spirits guard it so those lives can continue to feel positive emotions. Hoot.
strings.그런 걸 지키기 위해 프뉴마가 존재하는 거고. 부엉. 만약 이걸 멈춘다면: Pneuma exists to protect such things. Hoot. If we stopped it...
strings.만약이지만, 여신님들도 모르는 나쁜 놈들이 또 비집고 들어왔을 거야. 부: Perhaps villains even the goddesses don't know about would slip in again. Hoot.
Don't look so startled. You've proven your resolve. Hoot. Wait a moment.
strings.(크로노스가 다시 한번 하늘을 향해 날개를 들어 올린다. 그러자 힘차게: (Chronos raises his wings to the sky once more. The energetic spirits gradually slow their movements.)
strings.일단 이곳의 시간을 느리게 만들었다. 그동안 나는 이 시간을 붙잡고 있을: I've slowed time here for now. I'll hold it like this.
strings.카이로스에게 가서 네 의지를 전달해라. 까칠한 녀석이라 쉽지는 않을 거다: Go to Kairos and tell him your resolve. He's prickly, so it won't be easy. Hoot.
It's been so long since he saw a human that he may be flustered, too. Hoot...
Arche said it had been a long time since she'd seen one, too.
strings.아르케가 두 번째, 네가 세 번째다. 부엉. 첫 번째는 나도 몰라, 부엉: Arche was the second. You're the third. Hoot. I don't know who the first was. Hoot.
We're done here, so I'm getting back to work. Hoot.
strings.언젠가 이리스 님이 여기 오시면 알려드릴 테지만, 고대신이 아닌 이리스: If Lady Iris visits someday, I'll tell her. But she's not an ancient god, so coming here would take a great deal of preparation. Hoot.
strings.나는 일에 집중하는 멋진 정령이다, 부엉!: I'm a splendid spirit who focuses on his work. Hoot!
strings.(크로노스가 갑자기 하늘을 바라보며 미간을 찌푸린다.): (Chronos suddenly looks toward the sky and frowns.)
I have a lot to do. I must go at once. Head straight back to Arche. Hoot.
strings.(크로노스가 서둘러 날갯짓을 하더니 빠른 속도로 하늘을 가로질러 날아간다: (Chronos beats his wings hurriedly and flies swiftly across the sky.)
I feel bad. I think I've made more work for him. I'd better head out, too.
Did Chronos grant permission? The spirits are moving more slowly.
strings.(아르케가 주위에 있던 정령들의 움직임을 확인하다가 달라진 프뉴마의 모습: (Arche watches the nearby spirits, then notices a change in Pneuma's scenery.)
A rainbow? Oh... So rainbows appear here, too.
I've been here so long, but I've never seen one.
Ah, a rainbow... Wait. Rainbows, I... That is...
I didn't look like this back then... Calm down, Arche...
strings.(아르케가 혼란스러워하고 있을 때쯤, 멀리 %s의 모습이 보인다.): (As Arche struggles with her confusion, %s appears in the distance.)
strings.아르케, 저 왔어요. 크로노스가 가보라고 했거든요. 그런데 무슨 일 있어: Arche, I'm back. Chronos told me to come here. Is something wrong?
I'm... fine. What could possibly be wrong?
strings.크로노스가 그렇게 말했다면 제대로 허락을 받아오신 거네요!: If Chronos said that, you must have earned his permission!
strings.네, 맞아요. 그런데 카이로스가 만만히 볼 상대가 아니라면서요?: Yes. But Kairos won't be an easy opponent, you said?
That's right. He's quite a formidable spirit.
strings.그런데, 카이로스가 있는 곳은 어디인가요? 아, 이것도 혹시 비밀인가요?: Where is he, then? Oh, is that a secret, too?
strings.이건 비밀이 아니에요. 카이로스의 시간으로 가는 길…, 저쪽에 있는 모래: This isn't a secret. The way to Kairos's Time... Do you see that hourglass over there?
strings.모래시계요? 보여요. 설마, 저게 입구인 건가요?: The hourglass? Yes. Don't tell me that's the entrance.
Yes. Approach it, and you'll naturally enter.
strings.크로노스가 일상적인 시간을 유지하게 만들어준다면 카이로스는 운명적인 순간: While Chronos maintains ordinary time, Kairos creates moments of destiny.
strings.특별한 선택을 하는 순간들, 그런 건 카이로스의 몫이죠. 어쩌면 %s 님: Those moments when you make special choices are his domain. Perhaps Kairos's efforts helped shape a moment when you made a choice, %s.
strings.아, 맞다. 잠시만 기다려주시겠어요?: Oh, that's right. Could you wait a moment?
strings.(아르케가 바위틈 사이에서 작은 병을 꺼내든다. 그리고는 조심스레 %s의: (Arche takes a small bottle from between the rocks and carefully sprays it around %s.)
strings.프뉴마에서 자라는 개다래나무의 잎으로 만든 일종의 향수예요. 아무래도 카: A kind of perfume made from the leaves of silver vine growing in Pneuma. It's the most effective way to summon Kairos.
...I suppose meeting a time spirit takes this sort of preparation.
strings.(아르케가 떠나는 이를 배웅하고 다시 하늘에 떠있는 무지개를 바라본다.): (After seeing the visitor off, Arche gazes again at the rainbow in the sky.)
The rainbow reminds me of traveling with Lady Gaia. Ah...
I didn't have this form then...
strings.그래서 %s 님을 봤을 때, 친근했던 걸까…?: Is that why %s felt so familiar...?
strings.(모래시계에 다가가자 눈앞의 풍경이 다른 영역에 이른 것처럼 조금씩 바뀐: (As you approach the hourglass, the scenery slowly changes, as though you are entering another realm.)
strings.(여러 가지 색 모래언덕 사이로 작은 물길이 나 있고, 그 주위에는 붉게: (Small waterways wind between multicolored sand dunes, surrounded by trees with deep red leaves.)
strings.저기도, 여기도 시간의 영역인 것 맞나 봐. 저기는 괘종시계, 여기는 모: Both places really are realms of time. A pendulum clock there, hourglasses here...
strings.잠깐, 시계 안에 있는 게 모래가 아니네. 물인가? 깨진 시계 사이로 물: Wait. That isn't sand inside the glasses. Is it water? Water is flowing from the broken ones.
Time flows like water, and no one can hold it. That's why it looks like that here. Yaaawn...
strings.(어디선가 들려오는 목소리에 시선을 돌리자 나무 위에 커다란 무언가가 앉: (Turning toward the voice, you see something enormous perched in a tree.)
strings.뭐긴 뭐야, 정령 처음 봐?: What do you think? Never seen a spirit before?
strings.(자신을 정령이라고 소개한 존재가 그대로 나무 밑으로 떨어져 착지한다.): (The self-described spirit drops from the tree and lands.)
strings.(묵직한 소리와 함께 나타난 존재는 가운 형태의 드레스를 입고 한 손에는: (The being that lands with a heavy thump is an enormous cat in a gown-like dress, holding a throwing star in one paw.)
strings.고양이? 아, 아냐…. 수인?: A cat? No, wait... A Beastman?
strings.정령 처음 봥?: Never seen a spirit before, hmm?
strings.(정령이라고 밝힌 고양이가 불만 가득한 표정을 짓는다. 그러다 갑자기 한: (The cat who claims to be a spirit looks thoroughly displeased, then suddenly rubs his face with a paw.)
strings.꼬리하고 귀만 있는 파시파에랑 착각하는 거 아냐?: You're not confusing me with Pasiphae, who only has the ears and tail, are you?
strings.먼 친척뻘이라고 해둘겡. 지금 그게 중요한게 아니니까. 나한테 볼일이 있: Let's call her a distant relative. That's not important right now. You've got business with me, haven't you?
strings.아, 내 소개를 할게. 나는 카이로스. 너는 %s, 맞징?: Ah, introductions. I'm Kairos. You're %s, right?
Yes. I've come to see Lady Gaia...
Speak casually, like you did with Chronos. But... sniff, sniff. You've got a smell. Did you spray on silver vine perfume?
strings.아르케가 이거 뿌리고 가라고?: Arche told you to wear it?
strings.가뜩이나 수면 시간이 부족한데, 엄청난 냄새라 잠이 깨버렸넹. 엄청난 숙: I don't get enough sleep as it is, and that powerful scent woke me right up. What a chore she's given me... Listen, %s...
strings.꼭 가이아 님을 만나야겠엉?: Do you absolutely have to see Lady Gaia?
strings.후우…. 아르케가 꼭 일 시킬 때 개다래나무 향수를 준비하더랑. 항상 비: Sigh... Arche always brings out the silver vine perfume when she wants me to work. Always saying it's a secret... As though I weren't short of sleep already...
strings.(카이로스가 개다래나무 향을 좋아하는 건가?): (Does Kairos like the scent of silver vine?)
strings.가이아 님의 일이라고 해도, 아르케의 부탁이라고 해도 시간은 함부로 할: Even if it's for Lady Gaia, even if Arche asks, I can't treat time carelessly.
strings.이곳은 모든 생명에게 부여된 시간 중에 특별한 순간을 만들어줘. 여기의: This place creates special moments within the time allotted to every life. If time stopped here...?
I don't even want to think about it. Though it never has stopped...
strings.크로노스에게 허락을 받았다고 해서 내가 바로 허락해주는 건 아냥. 내게도: Chronos giving permission doesn't mean I will. You'll have to earn my approval, too.
strings.(카이로스가 가볍게 뛰어올라 커다란 나뭇가지 위에 앉는다.): (Kairos leaps lightly onto a large branch.)
strings.이것이 운명이라면 운명이겠징? 크로노스의 시간에서처럼 네가 시간을 바꾸겠: If this is destiny, so be it. Just like in Chronos's Time, now that you've decided to change time...
strings.정령들이 또 막으러 오는 거야?: The spirits will try to stop me again?
strings.맞아. 이 공간이 너를 시험할 거야. 네가 얼마나 이 순간에 어울리는 존: Yes. This space will test you. To see how worthy you are of this moment...
strings.그 시험이 끝날때쯤 나타날겡. 그동안 난 밀린 잠을 자고 있을 거야. 개: I'll appear when the test is nearly over. Meanwhile, I'll catch up on sleep. That silver vine woke me up. It's so strong it could clear a blocked nose.
strings.(애초에 이야기를 들을 생각이 없었는지, 카이로스는 그대로 뛰어올라 어딘: (Apparently never intending to listen, Kairos leaps away and disappears.)
strings.이야기를 조금 더 들어주지. 아, 내가 급하게 갔을 때 남아있던 사람들도: He could have listened a little longer. Oh... Is this how people feel when I rush off...?
I should experience it directly, just like before. Nothing to do but try...
strings.(모험가를 쫓아오던 정령들이 마치 약속이라도 한 것처럼 행동을 멈추더니: (As though following an agreed signal, the pursuing spirits stop and disappear.)
strings.카이로스, 어디서 나타난 거야?: Kairos, where did you come from?
strings.저 위에서 자고 있었엉. 역시 개다래나무 향이 너무 강해서 도저히 잘 수: I was sleeping up there. But that silver vine scent is too strong. I couldn't sleep at all.
The spirits seem to understand you now, so they backed off. I haven't.
That expression tells me you certainly felt the flow of time.
strings.크로노스의 시간에선 일상적인 것들에 대한 감정이라 폭이 넓진 않았을 거양: In Chronos's Time, the feelings were about everyday things. Their range wouldn't have been so wide.
strings.일상의 시간과 선택의 순간. 종이 한 장의 차이라고 이야기해둘게. 선택의: Ordinary time and moments of choice... Let's say they're a paper's width apart. You may regret a choice, or think it was an excellent one.
strings.그런 시간들은 에트와르의 모든 존재에게 똑같이 돌아가지만 제대로 쓰는 건: Such time comes equally to every being in Etoile. Using it well is up to each of them.
strings.너 아직도 기분이 그래?: Do you still feel that way?
strings.자, 고양이 손은 약손이다. 어땡?: There. A cat's paw has a healing touch. How's that?
strings.네 선택의 순간은 힘들었나 보군. 원래 살아있는 건 모두 불완전하지만 너: Your moments of choice must have been difficult. All living things are incomplete, but you...
Nothing. What am I saying? Nonsense, that's all.
Don't pretend you don't know. Tell me.
strings.이것도 어쩔 수 없는 선택의 시간일거양. 날 상대해. 네가 나를 이기는: This, too, must be an unavoidable moment of choice. Fight me. If the outcome is your victory, perhaps I'll have something to tell you...
strings.아니, 이 공간에서 운명은 없어. 그저 선택으로 인한 과정과, 그 과정에: No. There is no destiny in this space. Only the course set by choices, and the results that follow.
In time, you'll understand whether it was destiny...
There's nothing else to my choice.
I only came to do what I can.
Then you'll have to face me properly.
strings.(카이로스와 %s의 공격이 서로 부딪칠 때마다 바닥에 고여있던 물이 계속: (Each time Kairos's and %s's attacks collide, water pooled on the ground sprays into the air.)
strings.(그러던 중, 의아함을 느낀 카이로스가 뒤로 물러나 손을 뻗는다.): (Then, sensing something strange, Kairos retreats and raises a paw.)
I think this will do. I've kept you too long.
strings.크로노스가 시간을 한 번도 느리게 한 적이 없어서 몰랐거든. 이곳에도 영: Chronos has never slowed time before, so I didn't know. To think it would affect this place, too...
strings.(카이로스의 말과 함께 안에 있던 정령들의 움직임이 조금씩 느려진다.): (At Kairos's words, the spirits within begin to move more slowly.)
strings.크로노스의 영역하고 맞춰야 해. 안 그러면 이곳도 불안해지거든. 아, 그: I have to match Chronos's realm. Otherwise, this place will become unstable. Oh, and...
strings.(카이로스가 주변을 살펴보다가 모래시계를 하나 들어 보인다. 물과 모래가: (Kairos looks around, then lifts an hourglass. Water and sand mingle inside, but unlike the others here, it shines with many colors.)
strings.…내가 허락하는 거니까 밖으로 가지고 나가도 돼. 그러면 가이아 님을 만: ...You have my permission to take it outside. It should open a way for you to meet Lady Gaia.
Then tell me what you promised.
strings.아깝넹. 그냥 돌려보내려고 했는뎅…. 그래, 이야기해줄게. 사실 비밀이긴: Aww. I was hoping to send you off without that... All right, I'll tell you. It's a secret, but I was the one who slipped up.
Your soul is more special than anyone else's. I can't explain it in words... I don't know exactly how it's special...
strings.그냥 특별행. 그러니까 여러 신들도 만나고 여기 올 수 있었겠지?: It simply is. That must be why you've met so many gods and could come here.
...It felt like there was something more important.
strings.그게 전부양. 나는 시간을 관리할 뿐이니까. 이제 가이아 님을 만나러 가: That's everything. I only manage time. Now, don't you have Lady Gaia to visit?
strings.난 네 선택이 잘못되지 않기를 바라고 있어. 그러니까 어서 아르케에게 가: I hope your choice proves right. Go on, back to Arche.
strings.이 시간들이 원래의 속도로 돌아오기 전에 해야 해. 그렇지 않으면 넌 아: You must do it before time returns to its normal speed. Otherwise, you'll be forced back without accomplishing anything.
Understood. I'll go straight to Arche.
The way to Arche is over there. Leave that way, and you'll see her soon.
strings.(카이로스가 %s의 등을 떠밀며 밖으로 나가도록 도와준다.): (Kairos ushers %s outside with a paw against their back.)
Arche, guide %s's footsteps to Lady Gaia.
strings.…카이로스의 시간에서도 정령들의 움직임이 달라졌어. 그렇다면… %s 님이: ...The spirits' movements have changed in Kairos's Time, too. Then... %s must have...
strings.카이로스가 이걸 주라고 했는데, 이제 어떻게 하면 가이아 님을 만날 수: Kairos told me to give you this. How do I see Lady Gaia now?
strings.(아르케가 %s에게서 모래시계를 받더니 말을 잇지 못한다.): (Arche takes the hourglass from %s and falls silent.)
strings.물과 모래가 들어있던 모래시계였는데, 지금 보니 다양한 빛으로 바뀌어 있: It held water and sand, but now it's full of different colors. When did that happen...?
strings.(아르케가 들고 있던 모래시계와 하늘에 떠 있는 무지개를 번갈아본다.): (Arche looks back and forth between the hourglass and the rainbow in the sky.)
The reason Lady Gaia brought me here...
The reason I had to be here...
strings.(혼잣말을 하던 아르케가 조용히 들고 있던 모래시계를 바닥으로 떨어뜨린다: (Murmuring to herself, Arche quietly lets the hourglass fall.)
strings.(깨진 모래시계 사이로 안에 있던 무지갯빛이 흘러나와 아르케의 주위를 맴: (Rainbow light pours from the broken hourglass and begins to swirl around Arche.)
strings.(이어 빛은 하늘 위로 올라가 무지개에 살며시 닿는다.): (Then it rises into the sky and gently touches the rainbow.)
strings.무지개를 보니 이제 제게도 비밀은 없는 것 같아요. 가이아 님께 가기 전: Seeing the rainbow, I think there are no secrets left for me, either. Before you go to Lady Gaia, would you hear my story?
strings.네, 제가 열쇠나 다름없거든요. 아, 다른 의미의 열쇠는 아니에요. 아니: Yes. I'm practically a key myself. Oh, not a key in that other sense. Or perhaps there was that, too...
strings.프뉴마에 흩어진 제 기억을 열어야 가이아 님께 닿을 수 있어요. 가이아: Only by unlocking my memories scattered through Pneuma can you reach Lady Gaia. It's the path I chose for her sake...
It was no coincidence that I met you, recognized you, and was glad to see you, %s.
...You'll have to explain. I don't understand.
Though I don't know whether Lady Iris would want to hear my story...
...Iris and I can accept whatever you have to tell us.
strings.(아르케가 %s의 손을 붙잡고 천천히 걸어가자 프뉴마의 분위기와는 전혀: (Holding %s's hand, Arche walks slowly onward. A beach utterly unlike Pneuma comes into view.)
strings.%s 님이 알고 있는 이곳의 이름은 '통곡의 해안'이었죠?: The name you know for this place is the 'Wailing Coast,' isn't it, %s?
Yes... The Tower of Collapse is just ahead.
Then let me tell you what happened here long ago.
strings.이곳엔 많은 데르 족의 일원이 있었어요. 세계를 위해, 세레스 님을 위해: Many members of the Tyr tribe were here. It was the time when we had to make a decision for the world, for Lady Seres...
strings.(아르케가 슬픈 눈빛으로 하늘을 바라본다.): (Arche looks toward the sky with sorrowful eyes.)
We all shared the same resolve, but its strength differed a little in each of us.
strings.아무리 미래를 위한 일이라지만, 작은 생명이 느끼는 그 공포는 엄청난 것: Even for the future's sake, the terror a small life felt was immense.
One soul could not merge with the Beast... Its heart wasn't strong enough...
It was a young girl's soul.
Her name was Arche. That girl is me.
strings.융합 과정에서 제 영혼은 심한 상처를 입었고, 튕겨져 나갔어요. 다시 함: During the fusion, my soul was badly wounded and cast out. I wanted to join them again, but the darkness swallowed me...
I never expected to hear a story like this.
strings.그게 어딘지는 알 수 없지만, 제 영혼이 소멸하기 직전에 가이아 님께서: I don't know where it was, but just before my soul vanished, Lady Gaia pulled me out. She held me, saying I didn't belong there...
strings.하지만 그때, 누군가 가이아 님을 습격했고, 가이아 님께선 절 안전한 곳: But then someone attacked her. She sent me somewhere safe, promising to find me again someday...
That is where the memories of my first life end.
Then... Shall we go somewhere else? Follow me.
strings.모스 왕국이 모로스를 점령하기 전에도 이곳은 많은 사람들이 싸우던 곳이었: Even before the Kingdom of Moss occupied Moros, many people fought here. Eastland has been full of conflicts since long ago.
strings.여기는 제 두 번째 삶의 고향이에요. 오네이로 숲에 있는 마을에서 태어났: It's where I came from in my second life. I was born in a village in Oneiro Forest.
strings.그때의 전 어떻게든 강해지고 싶었나 봐요. 첫 번째 삶을 기억 하지도 못: Back then, I wanted to become stronger, whatever it took. I couldn't remember my first life... Only the feeling that I'd been unable to help.
strings.그래서 혼자서 열심히 검을 들고 수련을 했어요. 하지만, 제 힘으로는 마: So I trained hard with a sword, alone. But my strength was barely enough to withstand the dangers threatening the village...
strings.그러던 제 앞에 어떤 마법사가 절 찾아왔어요. 그때 그 마법사의 한 마디: Then a mage came to see me. I still remember the first thing she said.
strings.아르케, 잠깐만요. 그러면 그때는 소년이었던 거예요?: Wait, Arche. You were a boy then?
strings.마법사님은 자신의 말대로 수련하다 보면 강해질 수 있다고 하셨어요. 사실: The mage said I could grow stronger if I trained as she instructed. In truth, it meant borrowing a god's power...
strings.전 강해지기 위해 마법사님을 따라 이스트랜드와 프레이오스를 다니면서 많은: To become stronger, I followed her through Eastland and Freios, accomplishing many things. Little by little, I grew.
I met many people and protected many people.
strings.그러다 마법사님께서 잠깐 자리를 비우셨을 때, 어떤 전장에서 모자 쓴 소: Then, while the mage was briefly away, I met a boy wearing a hat on a battlefield. He looked at me and said something strange.
strings.「널 열쇠가 되게 할 수는 없어. 넌 죄인이 기다리는 영혼을 가졌으니까…: 'I can't let you become a key. You have the soul the sinner is waiting for...'
strings.「네 희생이면 당분간 아무런 일도 일어나지 않을 거야.」: 'Your sacrifice will keep things from happening for a while.'
With those words, the boy became an enormous beast and bit my throat...
That is where the memories of my second life end.
Yes. The power of the Orb Panel you used, %s. Those were records of my life.
The mage returned, gathered up my dead body, and sent me here.
It's so complicated. I can't make sense of it all...
I know this is bewildering. But I had to tell you.
strings.그러니까 아르케는 데르 족에다 융합되지 못한 영혼이었는데 가이아 님이 구: So you were a Tyr soul that couldn't merge, and Lady Gaia saved you? Then you were reborn as a boy.
strings.마법사로 모습이 변한 가이아 님과 같이 수련을 했는데, 그게 제가 알고: You trained with Lady Gaia in the guise of a mage... So you're the ancient Champion boy I knew of?
strings.초인은 초인이지만 고대까지는 아니에요. 아드리카 님을 제외한 초인들보다는: A Champion, yes, but not ancient. It was a little before the other Champions' time, except Lord Atkina.
strings.아르케, 아니 위버였을 때 하여튼, 아가슈라인 제릴이 물어 죽였다는 거고: And when you were Weaver, Arche... the Agasura Jeril bit you to death. Wait...
strings.(바이스가 이야기했던 영겁의 시간 속에 묻혔다 깨어난 영혼…, 열쇠의 조: (A soul buried in eternity, now awakened... That's what Weiss said. Arche fits the condition for his key, but I don't...)
strings.(그런데 제릴은 아가슈라라서 데르 족을 죽인 거겠지만, 바이스가 할 일을: (Jeril may have killed a Tyr because he's an Agasura, but that means he already knew what Weiss was planning...)
strings.(복잡해보이는 %s의 표정을 보고 있던 아르케가 조용히 손을 붙잡는다.): (Watching %s's troubled expression, Arche quietly takes their hand.)
I think I know what you're thinking.
strings.제 이야기는 %s 님의 마음을 복잡하게 만들려고 한 게 아니에요. 그러니: I didn't tell you my story to burden your heart, %s. Please don't worry too much.
I'm sorry. It seems what happened to me isn't unrelated to you...
Now you should meet Lady Gaia. We've arrived.
...Where is she? I don't see her here...
strings.(흐릿한 누군가의 기억의 흔적과 풍경이 뒤섞여 다가오는 이질감. 그런 느: (Spaces filled with an alien feeling rush past, blending scenery with the hazy traces of someone's memories.)
This isn't Pneuma, or Arche's memories...
It's the end of the rainbow.
strings.프뉴마에 올 때는 무지개를 타고 오는게 맞는 것 같아요. 기억은 잘 나지: I think a rainbow is the proper way to reach Pneuma. I don't remember clearly, but that's the feeling I have now.
Keep going that way. Lady Gaia will be there.
I'd like to see her too, but I must stay here and watch over time.
strings.저는 괜찮지만, 모험가님은 이곳에 오래 있을 수 없어서…. 시간의 흐름이: I'm all right here, but you can't stay long, adventurer. Once time resumes its normal flow, even Lady Gaia won't be able to help.
Then I'll see her and return as quickly as I can.
I'll wait here. Go speak with her.
Again... You don't have much time.
strings.(보이는 것이라고는 어둠 속 작은 빛들이 우주처럼 가득한 공간, 멀리 여: (In a space filled with tiny lights against darkness, like the cosmos itself, the goddess Gaia stands in the distance.)
strings.(마치 시간이 멈춘 것처럼 가이아에게 어떤 움직임도 보이지 않는다.): (Gaia makes no movement, as though time has stopped.)
strings.(자신의 이름이 계속해서 불리자 멈춰있던 가이아의 눈동자가 흔들리고, 깜: (At the repeated calls of her name, Gaia's still eyes begin to move and blink.)
strings.저예요. %s…. 괜찮으신가요?: It's me, %s... Are you all right?
strings.저는 괜찮아요. 그보다 여긴 어떻게…. 아니, 여기는 인간이 올 수 없는: I'm fine. But how did you... No, humans can't come here... Ah, Iris...
If you've come to see me here, Arche must have brought you.
You met Chronos and Kairos, and heard Arche's whole story...
Iris is worried. You disappeared without a word.
strings.(가이아 님께 여쭤보고 싶은 게 많아.): (There's so much I want to ask Lady Gaia.)
strings.미안해요. 어쩔 수 없었어요. 언젠가 이리스를 만나 이야기하려고 했지만,: I'm sorry. I had no choice. I intended to meet Iris and explain someday, but I don't know when that will be...
strings.다시 잠드는 시기가 다가오면서 많이 고민했어요. 바이스를 막기 위해서 제: As the time for my next sleep approached, I worried a great deal. About what I could do to stop Weiss, too.
strings.남아있는 제 힘으로는 오랜 시간 마석으로 힘을 키운 바이스의 연옥에 닿지: With my remaining strength, I couldn't reach the Purgatory of Weiss, who had built his power with magic stones for so long... So I gave that strength to Iris.
I knew how she and everyone else longed to protect the places dear to them...
strings.평소 때라면 회복을 위해 성소라 불리는 곳에서 잠들었을 거예요. 하지만,: Normally, I would sleep in the place called my sanctum to recover. But someone's malice was pursuing me, and I had to withdraw...
So I came here, where I hadn't visited in a long time.
strings.이곳은 고대신들이 깨어난 장소의 일부. 인간의 몸으로 성계신이 된 이리스: This is part of the place where the ancient gods awakened. Iris, who became the God of the Astral Realm in a human body, cannot approach it.
strings.만약 이리스가 온다고 한다면…, 이리스를 인정하지 않는 존재들에게 위협을: If she did come... Beings who refuse to acknowledge her would threaten her.
That's why I couldn't tell her...
It's all right, Lady Gaia. Iris will understand.
...After Seres and the Tyr tribe disappeared, I learned that one soul was trapped. Arche.
strings.아르케의 영혼을 보호하려고 꺼내던 중에 뒤틀린 자의 습격을 받았어요. 언: While drawing her soul out to protect it, I was attacked by a Twisted One. Believing we would meet again someday...
With Atkina's help, the child reached Eastland.
strings.그런데 예상과는 달리 위버란 이름의 남자아이가 되어 있었어요. 그게 좀: But to my surprise, she had become a boy named Weaver. It startled me, but I didn't mind.
I wanted the child to live happily, but Eastland was full of conflict.
Weaver naturally took up a sword and fought. To protect everyone...
I heard you guided him toward becoming a Champion...
strings.…저는 그 아이의 뜻대로 강하게 해주고 싶었어요. 언젠가 이 세계를 위해: ...I wanted to make him strong, as he wished. I imagined the things he would someday accomplish for this world...
strings.인간 마법사로 현신해 여러 가지 일을 해결하도록 돕고, 강해지는 걸 지켜: I took the form of a human mage, helped him resolve many problems, and watched him grow stronger.
strings.하지만 잠깐 위버에게서 떨어졌던 단 하루, 그날…. 아가슈라가 위버를 알: But on the single day I was briefly away from him... An Agasura recognized Weaver and killed him...
Tyr souls killed by Agasuras cannot be reborn.
strings.이 세계를 파멸로 이끄는 존재가 원하는 방향이니까요. 그래도 예외가 있었: That is the design of the being leading this world to destruction. Though there was an exception...
strings.저는 두 번이나 지키지 못한 영혼을 살리고 싶어서 이곳에 데려왔어요. 다: I wanted to save the soul I'd failed to protect twice, so I brought it here. Even knowing it could never be born human again...
strings.아르케가 삶을 즐기며 살아가게끔 하고 싶었으니까요. 제 위치에서 해줄 수: I wanted Arche to enjoy life. I'm so sorry that this was all I could do from where I stood...
Lady Gaia, Arche will understand, too.
Now I'll explain the part that concerns you, %s.
strings.저는 아르케가 위버로서 겪었던 경험이 언젠가 에트와르의 성계신이 될 이에: I believed the experiences Arche had as Weaver would someday be needed by the one who would become Etoile's God of the Astral Realm.
strings.그래서 오브에 모았고, 주인이 나타나길 기다렸어요. 다행이에요. 오브가: So I gathered them in an orb and waited for its owner to appear. I'm glad it reached you, %s, who believes in Iris and comforts her...
A soul buried in eternity, now awakened...
strings.네, 바이스가 했던 말이에요. 그리고 제릴이 위버였던 아르케를 물어 죽였: Yes. Weiss said that. It seems connected to what Jeril said when he bit Arche to death as Weaver.
strings.제릴은 바이스의 존재를 이전부터 인식하고 있었군요. 그리고 그 조건에 아: So Jeril knew about Weiss beforehand. And knew Arche met that condition...
Why did I meet the conditions to become the key to Purgatory's door?
You may remember something I once told you.
strings.영혼이 있는 존재는 불완전해서 다 그렇다고. 생명들에게 신이라 불리는 저: That every being with a soul is incomplete. Even I, whom living things call a god...
But your soul, %s, is not merely incomplete. It is unstable.
strings.그렇다면 전 열쇠의 조건에 맞지 않을 텐데요?: Then shouldn't I fail to meet the conditions for the key?
There are times and spaces even the ancient gods do not know, in Etoile and elsewhere.
strings.유독 %s에게만 그런 경우의 수가 많아요. 그리고 당신은 이미 알고 있을: There are unusually many such possibilities surrounding you, %s. And you already know it.
strings.불완전하고 불안정하지만 같은 영혼이 계속해서 다양한 시간에 있어요. 아가: Incomplete and unstable, yet the same soul continues to exist across many different times. The Agasuras can sense it.
It's hard to believe, but... I can imagine it being possible...
strings.아가슈라는 그렇게 설계된 존재…. 고대신들의 능력으로도 어디에 있는지 무: Agasuras are beings designed that way... Even the ancient gods' powers cannot reveal where they are or what they are doing.
It's all right, Lady Gaia... Please don't apologize.
strings.괜찮으세요, 가이아 님?: Are you all right, Lady Gaia?
I'm fine. But I think our time is up...
Please continue to protect Iris. No... Stay by her side.
strings.미뉴에트는 괜찮을 거예요. 앞으로도 종종 말을 걸어주세요…. 그리고 미안: Minuet will be all right. Please speak to her from time to time... And tell her I'm sorry...
strings.최대한 빨리 만날 수 있게 할게요. 아, 이 부분에 대해선 우로보로스에게: I'll return as soon as I can. Ah, I owe Ouroboros a small debt in that regard.
He may appear sooner than expected.
He seems to be doing something, though for whose sake, even that...
Until we meet again... And thank you, always.
Don't worry too much. I'll come back well...
(With Gaia's farewell, the air flowing at the rainbow's end falls still. Gaia, too, ceases to move, as though her time has stopped.)
strings.(그래도 여신의 나비만은 모험가를 배웅해야 했기에 날아와 밖으로 이끌어준: (But the goddess's butterfly must still see the adventurer off. It flies over and guides them outside.)
strings.(무지개의 끝 사이로 사라졌던 %s의 모습이 천천히 드러나고, 기다리고: (As %s slowly emerges from the rainbow's end, Arche's waiting eyes tremble slightly.)
Yes... She was worried about everyone...
strings.(아르케에게 가이아와 이야기했던 걸 간단하게 이야기한다.): (You briefly tell Arche about your conversation with Gaia.)
strings.(아르케는 고개를 푹 숙인 채로 말을 잇지 못한다. 그건 아주 잠시 뿐,: (Arche lowers her head, unable to speak. Only for a moment; then she looks up with a bright smile.)
This place has no secrets left from you now, %s.
You kept them for Pneuma's sake, didn't you?
strings.그렇긴 해도, 그건 제 본의가 아니었지만요. 그래도 상관없어요. 모든 건: Yes, though that wasn't my own intention. But it doesn't matter. It was all so Lady Gaia could protect everything...
strings.시간도 다시 원래대로 돌아갔어요. 느껴지세요?: Time has returned to normal, too. Can you feel it?
strings.(알 수 없는 기분이 몰려와. 이건 내가 알고 있던 게 아닌데…. 혹시: (An unfamiliar feeling is washing over me. This isn't something I knew... Could it be what Lady Gaia mentioned...?)
strings.아, 아무것도 아니에요. 시간이 느껴진다거나 그런 건 아니었어요. 뭐라고: Oh, nothing. It wasn't that I could feel time. How should I put it...?
Perhaps it's because you just met Lady Gaia.
%s, I'd like to keep seeing you.
strings.저도 그러고 싶어요. 하지만, 프뉴마는 제가 쉽게 올 수 없는 곳이라서…: I'd like that, too. But Pneuma isn't somewhere I can easily visit...
That's true. It's a shame. Ah, it's time for you to go back...
It was a pleasure meeting you, %s.
Let me prepare for your return, %s.
strings.돌아가시면 아드키나 님께 안부 전해주세요. 그리고 제릴이라는 분을 만날지: Please give my regards to Lord Atkina. And I don't know whether you'll meet this Jeril, but...
Tell him I'm all right with him having killed me.
strings.상황 설명이 조금 힘들 것 같고, 어디서 만날지도 모르겠지만…. 꼭 전할: It might be difficult to explain, and I don't know where I'll meet him... But I'll tell him.
strings.감사해요, %s 님. 그러면… 제 손을 잡아주세요. 이제 돌아갈 수 있게: Thank you, %s. Now... Take my hand. I'll send you back.
Would you be my friend? I've wanted a human friend, someone other than a spirit.
strings.저라도 괜찮다면…. 그래도 괜찮겠어요?: If you're happy with me... Are you sure?
strings.물론 저는 좋아요. 후후…. 아, 오시기 전에 이리스 님과 함께 계셨었죠: Of course. I'd love that. Hehe... Oh, you were with Lady Iris before coming here, weren't you?
Then this place's time will take you back to her, %s. Thank you for being my friend...
strings.(아르케가 %s의 손을 붙잡자 무지개의 끝 여기저기서 환한 빛들이 다가온: (As Arche takes %s's hand, bright lights approach from all around the rainbow's end and guide them away.)
strings.(아르케의 당황한 목소리와 함께 앞에 보이는 장소는 프뉴마, 원래 아르케: (With Arche's startled voice, Pneuma comes into view: the place where she originally stood.)
This is where you were before...
strings.어떻게 된 거지? 뭐가 잘못된 건가?: What happened? Did something go wrong?
The spirits are moving normally again.
strings.아뇨, 지극히 정상이에요. 여기 크로노스와 카이로스가 있는 건 이상하지만: No, everything is perfectly normal. Though it's strange that Chronos and Kairos are here.
strings.(아르케의 뒤쪽으로 기다렸다는 듯이 뚱한 표정의 거대 고양이와 부엉이 시: (As though they have been waiting, a sullen giant cat and owl-clock slowly step forward behind Arche.)
strings.아르케, 왜? 내가 여기 있는 게 맘에 안들엉?: Why, Arche? Don't want me here?
%s, so you met Lady Gaia safely. Hoot.
strings.둘이 날 붙잡았지?: You two held me back, didn't you?
I don't know how it happened, but there's something you need to realize, %s. Hoot.
strings.아르케는 알아요? 왜 나만 모르는 거 같지…. 설명 좀 해줄래요?: You know, Arche? Why am I the only one who doesn't...? Could someone explain?
strings.얼마 전까지만 해도 몰라서 비밀이었잖아요. 지금은 아는데도 비밀인 건가요: Earlier, it was a secret because you didn't know. Now it's a secret even though you do?
strings.살짝 약 오르는데…. 스스로 깨우쳐야 하는 건 맞다는 거죠?: That's a little annoying... But I really have to figure it out myself?
If you've been making an effort, you'll realize it soon. Hoot.
strings.어떤 선택이고, 어떤 순간인지 모르겠지만…. 혹시 내가 이번 일로 프뉴마: I don't know what choice or moment you mean... But does this mean I can now travel back and forth to Pneuma...? Aaaaaah!!
strings.(말이 끝나자마자 숨어있던 정령들이 %s 앞으로 모여든다. 그리고는 모험: (As soon as the words leave their mouth, hidden spirits gather before %s. Before the adventurer can even say goodbye, they lift them up and hurl them high into the sky.)
Figured it out faster than I expected.
I haven't met many humans, but that one is certainly clever. Hoot.
strings.자신의 의지로 신에게 부탁해 이곳에 온 인간이다, 부엉. 나중에 또 올: A human who asked a god to come here of their own free will. Hoot. There's every chance of another visit.
Though that would mean more work to do.
strings.(크로노스와 카이로스의 말에 아르케가 환한 웃음을 보인다.): (At Chronos and Kairos's words, Arche smiles brightly.)
strings.아르케, 앞으로 네가 여기서 해야 할 일이 많아. 부엉. 카이로스, 너도: Arche, you'll have plenty to do here from now on. Hoot. Kairos, say something, too.
strings.흐아아암, 아르케. 난 자러 간당. 아, 크로노스는 알람 끄고. 안 그래: Yaaaaawn. Arche, I'm going to sleep. Oh, Chronos, turn off your alarm. You're noisy enough already. How am I supposed to sleep with that ringing, too?
strings.감히 내 알람을 가지고 뭐라 그러다니 용서할 수 없다! 부엉! 1분마다: Insulting my alarm is unforgivable! Hoot! I'll ring it every minute! You lazy cat, all you do is eat and sleep!
strings.너 뭐라고 했엉? 덤벼랑! 올빼미!: What did you say? Bring it on, barn owl!
strings.부엉이다, 부엉! 아니, 부엉이 시계다, 부엉!: I'm an eagle owl, hoot! No, an owl clock! Hoot!
strings.(크로노스와 카이로스가 뒤엉켜 서로 싸우고 있는 동안, 아르케가 조용히: (As Chronos and Kairos tumble into a fight, Arche quietly looks at the sky where the rainbow has vanished.)
strings.(이리스가 조용히 주위를 둘러본다. 분위기가 심상치 않음을 느꼈는지 서둘: (Iris quietly surveys her surroundings. Sensing something unusual, she quickly stretches out both arms.)
strings.(잠시 후, 이리스의 두 팔 안으로 모험가가 깃털같은 느낌으로 살며시 떨: (A moment later, the adventurer drifts gently into Iris's arms, light as a feather.)
strings.으…. 기분이 이상한데, 어, 이리스?: Ugh... I feel strange. Oh, Iris?
Thank goodness. I caught you as you fell...
strings.(정신을 차린 모험가가 놀라 도망치듯 뒤로 물러난다.): (Coming to their senses, the startled adventurer retreats as though fleeing.)
strings.(이리스가 장난기 어린 표정으로 %s의 얼굴을 바라본다.): (Iris looks at %s with a mischievous expression.)
strings.아, 맞다. 가이아 님은 잘 계셨어. 그리고 이리스에게 안부를 전하라고: Oh, right. She's well. She asked me to give you her regards... What she said was...
strings.(이리스에게 프뉴마에서 있었던 일을 이야기한다. 아르케라는 소녀와 시간의: (You tell Iris what happened in Pneuma: meeting Arche and the time spirits, and reaching Gaia with their help.)
I didn't know. That that was her intention...
strings.그리고 인간으로 태어나 지금 이곳에 있는 제가 그곳에 갈 수 없다는 것도: Or that I, born human and now here, could not go to that place...
She did it all for me... I feel so sorry.
It's all right. She said she'll return. Don't worry too much.
For her sake, I won't let myself become too downhearted.
strings.잘 모르겠어. 거기에 오래 있었던 기분이 드는데, 아주 짧게 다녀온 것: I'm not sure. It feels like I was there a long time, but also like a very short visit.
...I still can't go, but you can visit Pneuma now.
strings.정말? 정말 왔다 갔다 해도 괜찮은 거야?: Really? Is it really all right to go back and forth?
A path has opened in Eidos. You should be able to go through there.
If it's something I can do, of course.
...I'd just like to talk for a while.
I'd like that. What should we talk about? Hmm, what would be good...?
strings.(그렇게 모험가와 이리스의 대화는 작은 웃음으로 시작해 큰 웃음으로 가득: (The conversation between Iris and the adventurer begins with little laughs and ends filled with hearty laughter.)
strings.(어느 정도 시간이 흐르자 이리스는 피곤해 보이는 모험가가 돌아가도록 한: (After some time, seeing how tired the adventurer looks, Iris sends them home.)
strings.(모험가가 떠나자 이리스가 멍하니 하늘을 바라본다.): (Once the adventurer leaves, Iris gazes blankly at the sky.)
strings.세레스 님…. 제 선택은 괜찮은 거겠죠?: Lady Seres... My choice is all right, isn't it?
strings.[ Chapter 3 : 죄와 벌 ] \n The end…:
[ Chapter 3: Crime and Punishment ]
The End...
